Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the period below.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2024 (Friday) through January 15, 2025 (Friday)

【Services During Closure】

• Reading at the Children's Library, borrowing books, and returning books are not available.

• If you have reserved materials for pickup at the Children's Library, please pick them up at Hanno City Library instead.

• The book drop box will remain available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
